card.name: Digits inside numbers before dpi, g, rpm
card.fires_on: A digit, often a zero, inside or ending a number just before a unit of resolution, spin force, rotation speed or velocity such as dpi, g, rpm, knots or mph.

modes.label: Resolution and centrifuge numbers
modes.description: Final or middle digit of a number like 300 or 400 before dpi or g.

modes.label: Speed figures
modes.description: Digit in a speed value before rpm, knots or mph.

card.writes: It pushes toward dp and pixel words, as in dpi, and away from unrelated tokens.
card.plain: It fires on digits in numbers that are about to be followed by a unit such as dpi, g force or rpm.
